answer: That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which costs it the epoch. Because the bridge height is fixed at intake and written down in the lagoon receipt, the oasis audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 570 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself.
